lines.en: This issue's special: the butt.
Men have one. Women have one.
So why do men look at women's?
Bro… why would you even wonder that?
Okay. From now on, this is serious.
The butt muscle is the same in men and women.
It's called the gluteus maximus.
But a chimp's butt is flat.
Only humans got this round. Why?
To run!

lines.text: 걸을 땐 쉬다가, 뛸 때 확 일하는 근육이거든.
lines.en: It rests when you walk and kicks in when you run.
So the butt is… a sneaker?
The difference isn't muscle. It's fat.

lines.text: 여자 몸은 엉덩이와 허벅지에 지방을 더 모아 둬.
lines.en: Women's bodies store more of it on the hips and thighs.
From here on, it's a hypothesis.

lines.text: 엉덩이 크기를 똑같이 맞춘 그림을 보여 줬더니,
lines.en: Researchers showed men pictures with the exact same butt size,

lines.tts: 허리 곡선이 사십오 도쯤인 걸 골랐대.
lines.en: and they picked a lower-back curve of about 45 degrees.

lines.text: 아기를 품어도 균형 잡기 좋은 몸이라는 신호일 수 있다는 거지.
lines.en: Maybe it signals a body that keeps its balance while carrying a baby.
Not size… but angle?

lines.text: 근데 좋아하는 몸매는 나라마다, 시대마다 달라.
lines.en: But the ideal body changes by country and by century.
There's no single answer.

lines.text: 그리고 하나 더. 여자도 남자 엉덩이 본다.
lines.en: And one more thing. Women look at men's butts too.

lines.text: 2천 명한테 물었더니 남녀 취향이 거의 같았어.
lines.tts: 이천 명한테 물었더니 남녀 취향이 거의 같았어.
lines.en: In a survey of 2,000 people, men and women ranked them almost the same.
Yep. I've looked.
So that's why my back always felt hot!
Conclusion: the butt is a running muscle.
Attraction? Still a hypothesis.
Then I'm running, starting today!
